note: Bighorn NF, near the top of the Bighorns on the Medicine Wheel Passage (US-14A), in spruce beside open meadows. Recreation.gov advises RVs to come in from Dayton via US-14/14A and Burgess Junction: the 14A climb from Lovell is a 10% grade it calls not recommended for RVs and motorhomes. Sites 11 and 12 share a spur, as do 14 and 15. --Claude
summary: rec.gov + FS current. $18.50 (rec.gov; FS page still says $20), 2nd vehicle $10, 8 people. 15 sites (12 reservable, 001/014/015 FCFS), 14-night max, no hookups, water + vault toilets, dump 25 mi. Season 2027 rec.gov 06-11..09-05. Pin fine. Not waterfront stands (tiny creek in willows ~30 m E of 006/007 - flag only). Lovell-side 14A grade warning is a route advisory with a recommended RV route, not a drop.
flags: FEE CONFLICT: rec.gov $18.50 (2024-2028 Peak Season) vs FS page 'Single Site: $20 per night'; rec.gov written.

ACCESS (not a drop): rec.gov 'From Lovell ... U.S. Highway 14A ... The highway has a 10% grade; not recomended for RVs and motorhomes. From Dayton ... via Burgess Junction. This is the recommended route for RVs and motorhomes.' The warning is for one approach only; the agency names an RV route. Kept in the note.

WATERFRONT 'not waterfront' stands; contrary claim as a re-audit lead: rec.gov 'Small creeks wind through the campground'. On imagery a 1-2 m stream runs N-S in a willow strip ~30 m E of sites 006 (44.80509,-107.85936) and 007 (44.80503,-107.85913), through shrubs; under the 30 m creek width it would at most be creekside, and the willow screen keeps it down.
HORSE/OHV: rec.gov amenities list 'Horse Staging Area', 'Hitching Racks', 'Off-Road Vehicle Trails'; FS 'Horse Camping'. A general family campground with these on the side; flag only.
STATUS: FS 'Site Partially Closed - Open to self-supported camping' is the after-season state; no status written.
